units.source_text: 为了躲避医生的视线，他把头转向了玻璃窗外。

en.t: To avoid the doctor's gaze, he turned his head toward the view outside the glass window.

units.source_text: 窗外除了插着空瓶碎片的砖墙之外，空空如也。

en.t: Outside the window there was nothing but a brick wall topped with shards of empty bottles.

units.source_text: 但是，砖墙上生长的薄青苔上也泛着斑驳的白。

en.t: But even the thin green moss growing on the brick wall was mottled with patches of white.
